candidate_history.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single RGBA building sprite for a realistic historical Chinese isometric town map. Year 1223 CE, Southern Song Lin'an/Jiangnan. Local south-facing entrance appears on screen lower-left facing wall. Main light comes from screen upper left, short soft contact shadow toward lower right only. True transparent background alpha; no white background, no checkerboard texture, no sky or surroundings. Center entire silhouette with minimum 10 percent transparent margin on EVERY side. Full eaves and base within image. No people, no characters, no readable writing, no signage text, no watermark, no modern objects, no Qing/Ming palace fashions, no excessive fantasy curls. Down-right ground edge has length 9 units, up-right edge 7 units, horizontal ratio 1.2857. Subject: One Southern Song Jiangnan stable structure, simple grey-tile gable roof supported by rough timber posts, open southwest-facing stalls divided by low wooden rails, stone trough, straw bales and wicker baskets, modest plaster back wall, no horses or people, compact clean flat ground footprint.
